summary.text: Eric Meschino is the Republican candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 12th Plymouth District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Kathleen LaNatra.
He advanced from the September 1, 2026 Republican primary and is a repeat candidate for the seat.

paragraphs.text: Meschino was the Republican nominee for the 12th Plymouth District in 2022 and 2024.
Kathleen LaNatra defeated him in the 2022 general election, 52.4 percent to 43.3 percent, with independent Charles F. McCoy Jr. receiving 4.2 percent.
She defeated him again in the 2024 general election, 53.1 percent to 46.8 percent.
